description: Check a source of a project's register against the open services now: its arXiv id against arXiv, its DOI against Crossref, its zbMATH number against zbMATH Open — whether the work is there and whether its authors (by surname), title and year are the record's. Every service agreeing makes it 'api' (checked by a service) and takes the † off; a service disagreeing or not having the work makes it 'mismatch' with the reason field by field, with the †; a service that does not answer changes nothing and is said in 'silent'. A source a person checked against the original, or a mismatch a person set, keeps their word: what the services say otherwise comes back as 'serviceNote', without the †. 'newerVersion' says arXiv has a later version than the one checked. MR and ISBN are asked nowhere. Sources are also checked by themselves when an identifier is written and weekly, so call this only when the person wants it now; at most 30 a project an hour, answers kept a day per identifier. With 'all' and 'project' instead of one source: every source of the project the services have not vouched for — unchecked, or a mismatch the services set, never a person's word — that has an arXiv id, a DOI or a zbMATH number is put in the background check's queue and asked over the next minutes, outside the ration; the answer is 'queued' (how many wait), and list_sources' 'queued' and each source's 'services.queued' say what is still waiting — read them again later rather than calling this again. Members of the project who may write only.

all.description: true: queue every source of 'project' the services have not vouched for, instead of checking one now.

id.description: The source's id, as list_sources returned it.

project.description: The project key, with 'source' — or with 'all'.

source.description: Its key or an identifier it has, with 'project'.

name: check_source
title: Check source
